tools.name: generate_invite_link
tools.title: Generate guest invitation link
tools.description: Generate a unique wedding invitation link for a guest. Returns a URL that opens the personalized invitation page for that guest.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the published wedding site, e.g. https://mywedding.lovable.app

guestName.description: Full name of the guest as it should appear on the invitation.

tools.name: send_telegram_notification
tools.title: Send Telegram notification
tools.description: Send a message to a Telegram chat via a bot. Useful for testing the wedding RSVP Telegram bot or sending custom notifications.

chatId.description: Telegram chat ID that will receive the message.

message.description: Message text to send. Markdown formatting is supported.

tools.name: build_map_embed
tools.title: Build Google Maps embed URL
tools.description: Convert a shared Google Maps URL or address into an embeddable map URL suitable for the wedding location section.

input.description: A Google Maps URL (share link, place URL, or embed URL) OR a venue address string.
